caption: The drawing features a rectangular upper section depicting a white and light blue two-story house with a central entrance, dark blue shutters, and a pedimented roof. In front of the house, there is a circular garden bed filled with brightly colored flowers, surrounded by a paved area and several tall, thin trees with green, yellow, and reddish leaves. Flanking the house, additional trees are present, and the background contains more vague, pastel-colored trees and sky. Below the rectangular section, the majority of the image is taken up by a large, circular layout that resembles a garden design plan. This plan is dominated by a big, pale blue circle edged by a wide green border. Inside this circle are three smaller circular features, with the largest in the center and two smaller ones above it to the left and right. Each of these circles contains a floral, geometric design in yellow, green, red, and purple tones, arranged in intricate, symmetrical patterns. The drawing’s color palette primarily consists of soft greens, blues, yellows, pinks, and purples, and the composition emphasizes the connection between the depicted house and the stylized, abstract garden below.
title: Ingraham Residence
